name: cuadrilo
description: A self-hosted platform for interactive language lessons: a lesson editor, live classes, homework and exercises (Express + React)
author: Aleksandr Shestakov

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.share: npm run build -w client && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm start -w server" "npm run preview -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w desktop
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
